benefits.terms: Demo terms: up to $250 back per qualifying prepaid stay of two nights or more booked through The Edit, on up to two bookings each calendar year.

benefits.terms: Demo terms: up to $150 back each half of the calendar year on dining at Sapphire Reserve Exclusive Tables restaurants.

benefits.title: $25 Monthly DoorDash Credit
benefits.terms: Demo terms: with an active DashPass membership, up to $25 each month in DoorDash promotions on restaurant, grocery and retail orders.
